exec git init -b main
exec card init --prefix graph-
exec sh -c 'printf "version: 1\nissue:\n  id:\n    prefix: graph-\n    strategy: sequential\n" > .cardamom/config.yaml'

exec card create 'Result task'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/create.txt
exec card result set graph-1 'Use the task result as durable context.'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/set.txt
exec card result show graph-1
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/show.txt
exec card --json result show graph-1
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/result.json

-- golden/result.json --
{"issue_id":"graph-1","title":"Result task","body":"Use the task result as durable context."}
-- golden/create.txt --
graph-1
-- golden/set.txt --
Set result on graph-1.
-- golden/show.txt --
Use the task result as durable context.
